description.value: A cozy 25-seat natural wine and cocktail bar tucked beside its sister restaurant Farmer's Apprentice in Vancouver's South Granville neighbourhood. The kitchen and bar emphasize low-intervention wines, seasonal ingredients, and a zero-waste ethos, turning leftover herbs and citrus peels into syrups and infusions. Walk-ins are welcome, making it an easy stop for cyclists exploring the area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 11m; stands (5 spaces) at 36m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Grapes and Soda is a 25-seat natural wine and cocktail bar at 1541 West 6th Avenue, Vancouver, with phone +1 (604) 336-2456. The menu clearly marks vegetarian (V), vegan (V+), gluten-free (GF), and dairy-free (DF) items. No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
